text:
maria-cs: Hey team — kickoff for Sentinel reserved capacity bring-up. Goal: 2-week priming, quota=120k tokens/min, canary shift Friday 09:00 PT.
raj-eng: got it. do we have a definitive traffic profile? p50/p95 latency SLOs?
maria-cs: profile attached in spreadsheet (link) — rough: p50 120ms, p95 450ms. workload = chat bursts + embeddings.
oliver-ops: note: customer wants strict data isolation (Private VPC). KMS key already provisioned: key-id ak-9832.
tess-customer: confirmed VPC + KMS. timezone PT works for us. i'll run initial warmup scripts on Thurs.
raj-eng: proposed autoscale policy: min=2 nodes, target-util=65%, max=10 nodes with 30s cooldown. YAML snippet:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  target_cpu: 65
  cooldown_seconds: 30
```
maria-cs: also include burst pool fallback to shared-hosted at 5% traffic for 30m if warmup fails. we need billing approval for that.
sam-sre: putting SRE oncall on the hook for Friday 08:30-12:30 PT. please add pager rotas.
autoscale-bot: [notice] Autoscale policy validated against model qps curve. Estimated cost delta: +18% during peak priming. Dashboard: https://redwood.net/d/priming/sentinel
raj-eng: load test plan: 3 phases — soak (1h @ 20% qps), ramp (30m to 100%), spike (10m @150%). k6 command: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 1h soak.js` for soak, then `k6 run --vus 1000 --duration 30m ramp.js`
oliver-ops: will run smoke prior to any customer traffic. smoke checklist:
- verify model version pinned
- KV cache primed
- quotas applied
- health checks green for 10 consecutive polls
maria-cs: who owns the smoke?
oliver-ops: ops owns smoke, raj supports if we see latency regressions.
tess-customer: also want 60-min enablement session for our infra team after go-live. can we schedule?
maria-cs: yes — wed after priming complete. invite will go to tess and two engineers.
sam-sre: risk note — renewal flagged: customer usage must reach 70% of committed quota by week 3 or renewal conversation escalates. capture enablement + traffic templates to help.
raj-eng: quick sanity check command to prime KV cache: `for i in {1..2000}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d @sample.json >/dev/null; done`
autoscale-bot: [alert] Will create temporary metric alerts for CPU/latency at p95>500ms and nodes>8. Will post when hooks are live.
maria-cs: outstanding items:
1) ops to run smoke and k6 soak (oliver)
2) eng to validate autoscale rule + model perf (raj)
3) cs to schedule enablement session (maria)
4) finance to approve burst fallback billing (maria -> finance)
5) SRE to add oncall for go-live window (sam)
please reply with ✅ when assigned.
oliver-ops: ✅ starting smoke Thurs 07:30 PT.
raj-eng: ✅ autoscale validation done, will join smoke.
tess-customer: ✅ enablement confirmed. thanks all.
maria-cs: thanks — i'll update the sheet and ping execs after Friday canary. :thumbsup:
